title: write  song on ai in 100 words

messages.content: write  song on ai in 100 words

(Verse 1)
Silicon dreams aur ek nayi light,
Screen ke parde pe chal rahi night.
Prompts tum daalo, mile instant reply,
AI ki duniya hai floating so high.

(Chorus)
Zeros aur ones ka yeh magic hai,
Future humara bilkul tragic nahi.
Data ke ocean mein kar le tu dive,
Smart algorithms making code alive!

(Verse 2)
Fast API ho ya CSS style,
AI bana de har project smile.
Naye ideas, naye se vision,
Tech world ka hai yeh best decision.

(Bridge)
Future is here, digital flight,
Shining so bright!

(Outro)
Mind meet machine, naya hai kamaal,
AI ke saath har din hai bemisaal!
